At the start of each of its turns it takes 7 (2d6) acid until it or another creature takes an action to scrape or wash off the acid.Cold Blast Fail: creature is restrained by ice until end of its next turn or until it or another creature takes an action to break it free. Success: creature’s speed is reduced by 10 ft. until end of its next turn.Fire Blast Fail: creature catches fire. Succcess: creature can’t take reactions until start of its next turn.Thunder Blast Fail: creature is deafened for 1 min. At the end of each of its turns a deafened creature can repeat the save ending deafness on itself on a success. Success: creature is deafened until the end of its next turn.

Whenever a creature that can see it starts its turn within 30' of it creature is charmed 1 min (DC 15 Wis negates). A charmed creature must take Dash action and move toward púca by safest available route on each of its turns trying to get within 5 ft. of the horse to mount it. Each time creature takes damage and at end of each of its turns it can re-save ending effect on itself on success. If creature’s save succeeds or effect ends creature immune to púca’s Beguiling Aura next 24 hrs.

special_abilities.name: Nightmarish Ride
special_abilities.desc: If a creature mounts the púca creature paralyzed and restrained by chains on púca’s back until the next dawn (DC 15 Cha negates paralysis and restrained). While it has a rider captured this way púca takes Dash or Disengage actions on each of its turns to flee with rider. After it moves 100' it disappears with captured rider magically racing along a nightmarish landscape. At the next dawn it returns to the space where it disappeared or the nearest unoccupied space the rider lands in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of púca and púca flees. At the end of the ride rider suffers one level of exhaustion.

tob3_sinstar.name: Sinstar
tob3_sinstar.senses: blindsight 60 ft., tremorsense 120 ft., passive Perception 14
tob3_sinstar.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, prone

legendary_actions.name: Teleport
legendary_actions.desc: Magically teleports up to 120' to an unoccupied spot it sees.

legendary_actions.name: Detonate Thrall
legendary_actions.desc:
Coste: 2 acciones legendarias.
Orders one of its star thralls to explode. Each creature within 10 ft. of the thrall must make a DC 19 Dex save taking 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and 7 (2d6) piercing damage on a failed save or half damage if made.

special_abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
special_abilities.desc: Choose to succeed failed save.

special_abilities.name: Spiny Defense
special_abilities.desc: A creature that touches the sinstar or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 10 (3d6) piercing damage and if the target is a Humanoid it must make DC 19 Con save or contract the thrall sickness disease (see the Thrall Sickness trait).

special_abilities.name: Thrall Sickness
special_abilities.desc: A Humanoid infected with this disease manifests symptoms 1d4 days after infection which include excessive thirst increased desire for exposure to sunlight and the appearance of itchy bumps on the skin. This disease wears down the victim’s psyche while slowly transforming its body. Until the disease is cured at the end of each long rest the infected creature must make a DC 19 Con save. On a failure the creature’s Dex and Int scores are each reduced by 1d4. The reductions last until the infected creature finishes a long rest after the disease is cured. The infected creature dies if the disease reduces its Dex or Int score to 0. A Humanoid that dies from this disease transforms into a star thrall under the complete psychic control of the sinstar that infected it. This otherworldly disease can be removed by the greater restoration spell or similar magic.

tob3_sinstar-thrall.name: Sinstar Thrall
tob3_sinstar-thrall.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned

special_abilities.name: Spiny Defense
special_abilities.desc: A creature that touches the star thrall or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 3 (1d6) piercing damage and must make DC 13 Con save or be paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: Telepathic Bond
special_abilities.desc: While the star thrall is on the same plane of existence as the sinstar that created it the star thrall can magically convey what it senses to the sinstar and the two can communicate telepathically.

bonus_actions.name: Hidden Step
bonus_actions.desc: Magically teleports along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying up to 30' to an unoccupied space it can see and takes the Hide action.

special_abilities.name: Distraction
special_abilities.desc: Each creature with Int 5+ that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the slithy tove must make DC 13 Wis save or be incapacitated until start of its next turn as it hears imaginary murmurings and sees movement in its peripheral vision. On success creature has advantage on saves vs. the Distraction of all slighty toves for the next 24 hrs.

bonus_actions.name: Nimble Flier
bonus_actions.desc: Takes the Dash or Disengage action. It must be flying to use this bonus action.

reactions.name: Parry Spell
reactions.desc: If it succeeds on save vs. spell of 5th level or lower that targets only snallygaster spell has no effect. If snallygaster succeeds on save by 5+ spell is reflected back at spellcaster using slot level spell save DC attack bonus and spellcasting ability of caster

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

special_abilities.name: Regeneration
special_abilities.desc: Regains 15 hp at start of its turn if it has 1+ hp.

tob3_snatch-bat.name: Snatch Bat
tob3_snatch-bat.languages: understands Deep Speech and Umbral but can't speak

special_abilities.name: Flyby
special_abilities.desc: Doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.

special_abilities.name: Treasure Sense
special_abilities.desc: Can pinpoint by scent the location of precious metals gemstones and jewelry within 60' of it and can sense the general direction of such objects within 1 mile of it.

tob3_sodwose.name: Sodwose
tob3_sodwose.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned, restrained, unconscious

bonus_actions.name: Grass Step
bonus_actions.desc: Teleports along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying up to 30' to an unoccupied spot it sees. The origin and destination spaces must contain grass.

bonus_actions.name: Set Snare
bonus_actions.desc: Creates a snare in a square area it can see within 30' of it that is 5 ft. on a side and 50%+ grass. 1st creature to moves into that space within next min: DC 15 Str save or be restrained by grasses. A creature including restrained creature can use action to free restrained creature via DC 15 Str check. It can have at most 3 snares set at a time. If it sets a 4th oldest ceases to function.

special_abilities.name: Grassland Camouflage
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: Dex (Stealth) to hide in grassland.

special_abilities.name: Scarecrow
special_abilities.desc: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 ft. of sodwose: frightened until the end of its next turn (DC 15 Wis negates and is immune to sodwose’s Scarecrow for the next 24 hrs).

tob3_soil-snake.name: Soil Snake
tob3_soil-snake.languages: understands creator's languages but can't speak
tob3_soil-snake.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 12
tob3_soil-snake.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone

special_abilities.name: Construct Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn’t require air food drink or sleep.

special_abilities.name: Grassland Camouflage
special_abilities.desc: Has advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks made to hide in grassland terrain.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

special_abilities.name: Protective Frenzy
special_abilities.desc: For 1 min after a splinter matron’s tree takes damage she has advantage on attack rolls vs. any creature that damaged her tree and when she hits such a creature with her Claw the Claw deals an extra 1d8 slashing.

tob3_stained-glass-moth.name: Stained-Glass Moth
tob3_stained-glass-moth.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

special_abilities.name: Construct Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn’t require air food drink or sleep.

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While motionless indistinguishable from ordinary stained-glass window or artwork.

special_abilities.name: Flyby
special_abilities.desc: Doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.

special_abilities.name: Immutable Form
special_abilities.desc: Immune: form-altering spells/effects.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

tob3_star-nosed-diopsid.name: Star-Nosed Diopsid
tob3_star-nosed-diopsid.languages: Deep Speech, Undercommon, telepathy 100' (300' w/its own kind)
tob3_star-nosed-diopsid.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 17

special_abilities.name: Mutagenic Venom
special_abilities.desc: Produces potent poison that envenoms Humanoid victim and slowly transforms it into new diopsid. While envenomed treats all diopsid as if charmed by them. Every 24 hrs that elapse victim : DC 16 Con save reducing hp max by 5 (2d4) on failure. Reduction lasts until creature finishes long rest after venom removed. Creature dies if this reduces hp max to 0. Humanoid that dies from this horrifically transformed becoming new diopsid and losing all memory of its former life. Poison remains within creature’s body until removed by greater restoration or similar.

bonus_actions.name: Reel
bonus_actions.desc: Pulls up to 2 creatures grappled by it up to 15 ft. straight to it.

reactions.name: Wing Trap Snap
reactions.desc: When 1+ creatures step onto a space on ground within 10 ft. directly above a hidden stargazer stargazer can burrow up to 10 ft. and snap its wing-like appendages shut emerging on the ground in space directly above where it was buried and that contains one or more other creatures. Each creature must make DC 16 Dex save or be trapped as if it failed save vs. Wing Trap.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

special_abilities.name: Tendril Whip Regrowth
special_abilities.desc: Has 12 tendrils. If all are destroyed can't use Tendril Whip. Destroyed tendrils regrow when it finishes long rest.

tob3_starving-specter.name: Starving Specter
tob3_starving-specter.languages: the languages it knew in life

special_abilities.name: Aura of the Forgotten
special_abilities.desc: Beasts and Humanoids within 10 ft. of the starving specter have disadvantage on saves.

special_abilities.name: Ethereal Sight
special_abilities.desc: Can see 60' into the Ethereal Plane.

special_abilities.name: Incorporeal Movement
special_abilities.desc: Move through others/objects as difficult terrain. Takes 5 (1d10) force if it ends turn in object.

special_abilities.name: Life Hunger
special_abilities.desc: When a creature specter can see regains hp specter's next Bite deals extra 7 (2d6) necrotic on a hit.

special_abilities.name: Undead Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

special_abilities.name: Unnerving Visage
special_abilities.desc: When a creature that can see specter’s faces starts its turn within 30' of it at least one of specter’s faces shifts to look like one of the creature’s departed loved ones or bitter enemies if specter isn’t incapacitated and can see the creature. Creature takes 7 (2d6) psychic and is frightened of specter until start of its next turn (DC 14 Wis negates both). Unless surprised a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the save at start of its turn. If creature does so it can’t see the specter until the start of its next turn when it can avert again. If creature looks at specter in the meantime it must immediately save.

tob3_stone-eater-slime.name: Stone-Eater Slime
tob3_stone-eater-slime.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, petrified, prone

special_abilities.name: Amorphous
special_abilities.desc: Move through space 1ft.+ wide with o squeezing.

special_abilities.name: Ooze Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn’t require sleep.

special_abilities.name: Spider Climb
special_abilities.desc: Difficult surfaces even ceilings no ability check.

special_abilities.name: Diurnal
special_abilities.desc: At night or when underground it has disadvantage on initiative rolls and Wis (Perception) checks.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

special_abilities.name: Speak with Plants
special_abilities.desc: Can communicate with plants as if they shared a language.

special_abilities.name: Variable Illumination
special_abilities.desc: Sheds bright light in a 5 ft. to 20' radius and dim light for extra number of feet equal to chosen radius. It can alter radius as a bonus action. It can’t use this trait if it hasn’t been exposed to sunlight in past 24 hrs.

tob3_swampgas-shade.name: Swampgas Shade
tob3_swampgas-shade.languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak
tob3_swampgas-shade.condition_immunities: exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

bonus_actions.name: Swampland Stealth
bonus_actions.desc: Takes the Hide action. It must be in swampy terrain to use this bonus action.

special_abilities.name: Amorphous
special_abilities.desc: Move through space 1ft.+ wide with o squeezing.

special_abilities.name: Rejuvenation
special_abilities.desc: If it dies within its bound region shade returns to life in 1d4 days and regains all hp. This doesn’t function if shade is put to rest which occurs after its corpse has been reburied outside swamp.

special_abilities.name: Swamp Camouflage
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: Dex (Stealth) to hide in swamp.

special_abilities.name: Swampbound
special_abilities.desc: Is bound to a region of swamp within 1 mile of its body. If shade leaves region loses its Soul Drain action until it returns to the region. If it remains outside region automatically teleports back to its corpse after 24 hrs regardless of distance.

special_abilities.name: Undead Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

tob3_swarm-biting-gnat.name: Swarm, Biting Gnat
tob3_swarm-biting-gnat.condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned

special_abilities.name: Blood Sense
special_abilities.desc: Can pinpoint by scent the location of warm-blooded creatures within 20' of it.

special_abilities.name: Distracting Buzz
special_abilities.desc: A creature that is not deafened and starts its turn in a space occupied by a swarm of biting gnats must make DC 10 Wis save or become distracted by the droning of the gnats’ wings. A distracted creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks that use Int Wis or Cha for 1 min. A creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself. If a creature’s save is successful the creature is immune to the swarm’s Distracting Buzz for the next 10 min.

special_abilities.name: Swarm
special_abilities.desc: Can occupy another creature’s space and vice versa and swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny beast. Can’t regain hp or gain temp hp.

tob3_swarm-gryllus.name: Swarm, Gryllus
tob3_swarm-gryllus.languages: understands those of its creature but can't speak
tob3_swarm-gryllus.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned

special_abilities.name: Book Bound
special_abilities.desc: Hp max is reduced by 1 every min it is more than 60' from its book. When hp max reaches 0 dies. If its book is destroyed or moved to another plane of existence separate from swarm must make DC 11 Con save or be reduced to 10 hp. Swarm can bind itself to new book by spending a short rest in contact with the new book.

special_abilities.name: Construct Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn’t require air food drink or sleep.

special_abilities.name: Immutable Form
special_abilities.desc: Immune: form-altering spells/effects.

special_abilities.name: In the Margins
special_abilities.desc: Can spend half its move to enter/exit its book. While inside its book it is indistinguishable from illustrations on a page.

special_abilities.name: Swarm
special_abilities.desc: Can occupy another creature’s space and vice versa; can move through opening large enough for Tiny construct. Can’t regain hp or gain temp hp.
